CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: King kills spawn a reward wave of lane creeps for the killer's team, advanced to the center node with bonus HP -- a real board-state consequence beyond the existing buff/econ reward (boss-death-as-match-event, closes a gap named twice in NORTHSTAR §22.6/22.7).
